name: specialCharacter
author: Chai Chaimee
description: Special Character is an NVDA add-on that lets you instantly insert symbols and special characters anywhere. It features two customizable sets of twelve slots, a dedicated settings panel, and context-aware insertion logic for various apps. It also includes smart tap control, dedicated dash shortcuts, and persistent configuration. Hot Keys: Ctrl+0-9, Ctrl+Minus, and Ctrl+Equals : Insert Slot 1-12 Shift+Windows+. : Insert En Dash Shift+Windows+/ : Insert Em Dash Shift+Backspace Single tap: Toggle character set Double tap: Toggle On or Off
